title: No Literal Color Regression Test Purpose
description: Enforces PRD §17 Wave 2's acceptance condition that no literal color values escape the tokens file.
body: PRD §17 Wave 2's acceptance condition is 'packages/schematify-ui holds no literal hex value' (updated to apps/schematify/ui/ per audit baseline). The test expands beyond hex to cover rgb(), rgba(), hsl(), hsla(), hwb(), lab(), lch(), oklab(), oklch(), and color-mix() functional forms, plus all 147 CSS named-color keywords, because every one bypasses --kv-* tokens exactly as a hex literal would. The test exempts tokens.css (which holds the design token definitions) and this file itself (whose positive-control test fixtures need literal colors to verify the patterns catch them). Two files are exempt by design; no others are allowed.
